waivers.reason: libuuid/util-linux HIGH CVE in the nginx:stable-alpine (Alpine 3.24) base image used by apps/web/Dockerfile. Fixed upstream in util-linux 2.42.3-r0, but that build is not yet published in the Alpine 3.24 apk repository, so `apk upgrade --no-cache` in the Dockerfile cannot pull it. Confirmed unrelated to any application code change: reproduces identically on main (unchanged Dockerfile). Re-check and drop this waiver once Alpine 3.24 ships the fixed package.
